evidence.comment_at_line_92: [Wave 3b KDS Adversarial P0 2026-05-18 KDS-ADV3B-01] ... binding Paris-local midnight as-is shifted the active window by 1-2h, silently dropping nightly orders [00:00-02:00 Paris] from the KDS UI hydration.

findings.verdict: whereBetween + UTC-converted Paris-day-bounds uses idx_orders_datetime efficiently. Mirror applied to orderItems() at lines 283-295 and KdsSyncService.php:77-94. PASS.
findings.audit_status: Read-verified, mirror confirmed across both services

findings.title: Potential N+1 in orderItems() pluck-then-groupBy chain — collection traversal is in PHP memory after a get()
findings.impact: When KDS has 50 active orders × 8 items avg = 400 OrderItem rows pluck/flatten/groupBy/map in PHP. Not a DB N+1 (orderItems is eager-loaded), but: (a) no LIMIT 50 on this query unlike list() at line 150 — orderItems() returns unbounded; (b) hash computation in groupBy callback runs for every item including sha1+json_encode of allergens.
findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Add ->limit(50) to itemBoard query (mirror list()). Add server-side cache (1-2s TTL) similar to KdsSyncService::sync. Estimated 1h.

findings.title: Missing composite index on orders(status, order_datetime) — single-status path queries fall back to less optimal plan

evidence.missing_index: (status, order_datetime) — admin global query (no branch filter) would benefit from composite covering the WHERE status IN (...) AND order_datetime BETWEEN bounds
evidence.current_indexes: idx_orders_branch_status + idx_orders_datetime separate — MySQL optimizer must merge

findings.impact: Admin-global KDS view (branch_id=0) with high throughput: index merge between idx_orders_status and idx_orders_datetime is slower than a single composite covering both. With 50+ active orders, EXPLAIN may show 'Using intersect' which is suboptimal at high cardinality.
findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Add migration: $table->index(['status', 'order_datetime'], 'idx_orders_status_datetime'); only if EXPLAIN on production shows index-merge cost. Estimated 30min + measurement.

findings.title: Limit 51 with take(50) overflow detection pattern is correct
findings.verdict: Classic 'fetch n+1 to detect overflow' pattern, correctly implemented. Overflow flag exposed via lastListOverflow() and surfaced in KitchenDisplaySystemController.php:32 meta.overflow. PASS.

findings.title: Optimistic concurrency control via expected_status + lockForUpdate is correctly implemented
findings.verdict: DB::transaction wraps SELECT FOR UPDATE + check + UPDATE. On stale expected_status, abort(409) WITHOUT mutating row. Triple-defense: DB lock + optimistic check + audit log. PASS.

findings.title: KdsSyncService cache TTL of 5s + minute bucket could cause version stalling at minute boundary
findings.impact: Cache key includes minute bucket, so even within 5s TTL, a request crossing the minute boundary generates a NEW cache key and re-queries. Acceptable but causes thundering herd at :00 second every minute when many KDS clients poll simultaneously. Minor; load testing would confirm impact.
findings.scope_minimal_heal_recommendation: Defer — measure first. If thundering herd observed, add cache stampede protection (lock-based regeneration). Estimated 2h.
